title: Happy owl
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='26' ry='28' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
    <!-- belly -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='17' ry='19' fill='#E8C88A'/>
    <!-- belly feather chevrons -->
    <path d='M42 60 q8 6 16 0' stroke='#C99B57' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
    <path d='M41 68 q9 7 18 0' stroke='#C99B57' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
    <path d='M43 76 q7 6 14 0' stroke='#C99B57' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
    <!-- wings -->
    <ellipse cx='24' cy='62' rx='8' ry='18' fill='#6E4A2E'/>
    <ellipse cx='76' cy='62' rx='8' ry='18' fill='#6E4A2E'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='27' ry='23' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
    <!-- ear tufts -->
    <path d='M27 20 L30 34 L38 24 Z' fill='#6E4A2E'/>
    <path d='M73 20 L70 34 L62 24 Z' fill='#6E4A2E'/>
    <!-- eyebrow tufts -->
    <path d='M31 26 q9 -6 17 -1' stroke='#5A3B24' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M69 26 q-9 -6 -17 -1' stroke='#5A3B24' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- face disc -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#D9B77C'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='41' cy='34' r='8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='34' r='8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='41' cy='34' r='5' fill='#FFB000'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='34' r='5' fill='#FFB000'/>
    <circle cx='41' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
    <circle cx='43' cy='32' r='1.4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='61' cy='32' r='1.4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <!-- beak -->
    <path d='M50 40 L45 48 Q50 52 55 48 Z' fill='#F2A93B'/>
    <path d='M50 47 L50 45' stroke='#C97E1E' stroke-width='1.4'/>
    <!-- feets -->
    <path d='M40 88 l-6 6 M40 88 l0 7 M40 88 l6 6' stroke='#F2A93B' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M60 88 l-6 6 M60 88 l0 7 M60 88 l6 6' stroke='#F2A93B' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
